{{Quote|Send a detachment down. Make sure he's eliminated.|The ARC trooper, to a clone, regarding Padawan Joc Sah, after killing Jedi Master Sev|<ref name="TOoO">{{CWACite|5|The Order of Outcasts}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''ARC trooper''' served under the command of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]]. In the war's [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] accompanied Master Sev and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Joc Sah]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ragmar V]], which was considered a vital staging planet for a planned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] attack on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base. After Sev dispatched Sah to the planet's surface in order to secure a base for the Republic, the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] was commanded by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] that branded all [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] as traitors to the Republic. The [[Commando/Legends|commando]] and the other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] immediately [[Death/Legends|killed]] Sev, traveled down to the planet's surface, and [[Battle of Ragmar V|attacked]] the village where Sah and the outcasts with whom he had formed an alliance were based.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Fire at will!|The ARC trooper instructs his forces to attack Sah, Gaan, and their allies|<ref name="TOoO" />}}
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], this [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was bred on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="databank" /> An [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], he was trained to serve on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE-ARC">{{CSWECite|I|12-13|Advanced Reconnaissance Commando (ARC trooper)}}</ref> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|initiated]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was eventually placed under the command of the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]].<ref name="TOoO" />

[[File:Sev_ARC_trooper.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ARC trooper commands his troops to attack Joc Sah, Gaan, and their allies.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the war's final [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ARC trooper traveled with Sev and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Joc Sah]], to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Ragmar V]], which the Republic viewed as an essential staging planet that was necessary for a planned assault on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] base. The clone remained aboard Sev's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] as the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] dispatched Sah and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to the planet's surface in order to secure a base for the Republic. Shortly after Sev's and Sah's conversation, the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] was contacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|instructed]] him to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;an order which labeled the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] as traitors to the Republic&mdash;and to thus [[Death/Legends|kill]] Sev. The ARC trooper and the other clones on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] attacked Sev and slew the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master. After Sev's demise, the ARC trooper went with a detachment of clones to the planet's surface and [[Battle of Ragmar V|attacked]] the village where Sah and the settlement's leader,<ref name="TOoO" /> [[Gaan]],<ref name="Gaan">{{CSWECite|I|305|Gaan}}</ref> were located.<ref name="TOoO" /> The Jedi and the village leader ultimately survived the battle and proceeded to stage a number of hit-and-run attacks against the ARC trooper's forces.<ref name="Sah Joc">{{CSWECite|III|123|Sah, Joc}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:SevARC trooperInLead.jpg|right|thumb|300px|The ARC trooper is leading the attack into the outpost of outcasts]]
As an ARC trooper, the man was personally trained by Jango Fett and possessed the Mandalorian's ruthlessness and efficiency. He was trained to be self-sufficient, although he was not entirely independent.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Like most clone troopers,<ref name="databank" /> the commando was bred to be utterly loyal to the Republic and to follow his orders from [[Commanding officer/Legends|superior officers]]. The clone's loyalty to the Republic prompted him to execute Order 66 without hesitation, succeeding in eliminating Sev; the ARC trooper also made it a point to personally lead a detachment of soldiers in order to eliminate Joc Sah.<ref name="TOoO" />

The ARC trooper wore a set of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I class]] [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|armor]] adorned in [[Color/Legends|yellow]] which was also worn with a blast dampening [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] and rank-signifying [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]. He used an [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A rifle]] during combat.<ref name="TOoO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC trooper was introduced in the short story ''[[The Order of Outcasts]]'', which was one of four [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] trade paperbacks. The character was created by [[Matt Jacobs]] and drawn by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].<ref name="TOoO" /> In [[2008]], [[Hasbro]] created an action figure of both the ARC trooper and Sev as part of the second wave of the Order 66 part of its [[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|''30th Anniversary Collection'']].<ref name="Figure" />
